However, my experience at the Chembur (Mumbai) salon has been so appalling that it cannot be ignored.

The hygiene standards are absolutely pathetic. The sinks were dirty and clearly not cleaned before use, and I was expected to sit there for hair services. A stylist named Sonali falsely claimed to be the “senior-most” stylist and refused to connect me to the actual Style Director despite repeated requests. She had no clarity on what she was doing and completely messed up my hair. There was no proper consultation, no understanding of colour, and no accountability—only arguments and careless handling.

Despite raising complaints, the same stylist was repeatedly assigned to me, and my hair is still not properly fixed. This is unacceptable.

If this is how a loyal, regular customer is treated, it raises serious concerns about how this salon is being managed—especially in a market where there is so much competition with far better quality and a customer-first mindset.

It is high time the Chembur salon seriously upgrades its staff professionalism and hygiene standards. The management and owners need to step in immediately. If there are any authorities responsible for salon hygiene and service quality, this place definitely needs to be inspected.

Highly disappointed.

My body has no tension left whatsoever. Finally, Mayuri took good care of me and gave me a great consultation, she listened to what I wanted and suggested treatments based on my needs. She also got me set for my next treatment in a few days. Book your appointment ASAP! This is my favorite salon in India and I’ll be back as soon as possible
